text:
anna_sales: Heads-up — GlobalRetail asked for a compact evidence pack for their vendor risk review. They want: (A) admin/audit event sample (redacted), (B) SIEM-ready mapping (Splunk/ECS), (C) retention/exfil controls text, and (D) a signed logging attestation they can upload to their VRM. Can we deliver this as a single ZIP?

sam_solutions: Yes. Proposed contents: 1) cloudtrail_7d_redacted.jsonl (7-day sample) 2) app_admin_14d_sample.jsonl (application admin events) 3) ecs-mapping.md (field map) 4) retention_policy_excerpt.pdf 5) logging_attestation_signed.pdf + README.md with ingestion notes.

jess_engineering: I can generate the CloudTrail sample scoped to EU regions and obfuscate IPs. Quick example of our redaction rule: replace last octet with 0 and hash usernames. Script snippet: 
```bash
# redaction example
jq '.Records[] | .userIdentity.userName |= ("redacted_" + (. | tostring | gsub("[^") ))' cloudtrail.jsonl > cloudtrail_redacted.jsonl
```
I'll run in eu-west-1 and put results in a temporary bucket with a presigned URL (48h).

mike_security: Redaction checklist: remove/obfuscate IPs, useremail, sessionToken, requestParameters with PII. Keep: eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.arn (redacted), awsRegion, eventSource, requestID. Document the redaction in README and include a signed statement we didn't alter event semantics.

lina_product: GlobalRetail specifically asked whether we log admin.role.update, api_key.create, and oauth.client.revoked. Confirm we capture those at both platform and application level.

sam_solutions: Confirmed. Platform-level actions (instance start/stop, iam changes) are in CloudTrail. Product-level admin events (api_key.create, role assignments, oauth events) are in our app-audit stream. We'll include a 14-day sample for the app-audit file.

legal_ops: We'll need to review before sharing anything. Are we including customer data? If not, we can approve quickly with security note.

mike_security: No customer PII. We should add a short attestation line: "I confirm the exported logs have been programmatically redacted to remove PII per Redwood policy." I will sign the attestation once the samples are ready.

infra_ops: Creating an EU bucket is fine. Ops-bot: provisioning jira-3247 to create transient bucket acme-vrm-export-eu (retention 7d).

ops-bot: jira-3247 created: transient-bucket-provisioning assigned to infra_ops.

anna_sales: ETA? They want artifacts in 48 hours. Is that doable?

jess_engineering: If legal + security clear today, I can run exports and upload within 24 hours. Mapping doc and README I can have same day.

sam_solutions: I'll draft the README and an ingestion quickstart for Splunk (HTTP Event Collector example) and QRadar (CEF mapping).

mike_security: Also include a screenshot of our SIEM ingestion dashboard (sanitized, no IDs). That demonstrates end-to-end delivery.

lina_product: Please also add a short paragraph titled "What we log - admin scope" listing the concrete events and example schemas so the VRM reviewer doesn't chase us for clarifications.

anna_sales: Action list pinned: @mike_security finalize redaction checklist + sign attestation (today); @jess_engineering produce redacted CloudTrail (eu-west-1) + app-audit sample (tomorrow); @sam_solutions create ECS/Splunk mapping + README + quickstart (tomorrow); @legal_ops approve share (today). I'll update the deal notes and tell GlobalRetail we aim to deliver in 48h.

legal_ops: Can we get a sample of the redaction output before we sign off? A single event will do.

jess_engineering: Yes — I'll paste one sanitized event to the thread in a minute.

jess_engineering: Sample event (sanitized):
```json
{"@timestamp":"2026-03-18T09:22:11Z","event.action":"admin.role.update","user.name":"redacted_user_1","source.ip":"52.16.8.0","cloud.provider":"aws","aws.region":"eu-west-1","event.source":"iam.amazonaws.com"}
```

mike_security: That looks good. Provide one app-audit sample too (no PII):

jess_engineering: App-audit sample:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-17T14:05:02Z","event":"api_key.create","actor":"svc_account_7","resource":"apiKey","details":{"key_id":"redacted","env":"prod"}}
```

sam_solutions: I'll include mapping entries that show how api_key.create maps to event.action and where to find actor -> user.name.

anna_sales: Anything else?

mike_security: Please ensure we call out retention windows in README: log hot-retention = 180 days, archive to cold storage = 2 years (730 days). Also call out access controls (SSE-KMS, bucket policies, limited IAM roles).

lina_product: Add mention that exports are ephemeral and we provide presigned URLs valid 48 hours.

anna_sales: Great. I'll update GlobalRetail with this plan and timeline. Thanks team :rocket:
